runtime.dependency_identity_scope: existing interpreter and jsonschema version/metadata, NOT full package distribution/release closure

import: load exact file via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, install module in sys.modules before exec_module as in frozen test; before loading verify pinned original raw hashes; no production CLI or automatic stage chaining

context.path_policy: canonical absolute, no dot segments/links/junction/archive, exact allowlist and raw hash; filesystem race/OS permissions not authenticated by JSON

functions.name: materialize(bindings)
functions.input: exact seven slots in unchanged intent-template.json, actual setup and external authority refs; strict final Schema
functions.output: complete parsed exception intent; no source mutation

functions.name: assemble(raw, ctx, prepared_at, receipt_path)
functions.input: exact UTF8 request raw bytes, checked context, initial caller-captured datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(), exclusive future receipt path
functions.output: complete candidate bytes, pending postwrite verification; timestamp retained in frozen F1
functions.frozen_reproduction: use same F1 prepared_at verbatim, do not sample clock again

functions.name: commit(f1ref, gateref, ctx)
functions.input: exact frozen F1/gate refs; phase authority and source governance independently satisfied
functions.output: EXCEPTION_RECEIPT only when exclusive receipt write succeeds
functions.failure_contract: FAILED_BEFORE_REPLACE/UNKNOWN_AFTER_REPLACE: no replay; OutcomeUnavailable carries result with status/receipt_error/attempt_start_path/receipt_path/read_only_reconcile_required; receipt unavailable must never be called durable success

stage_order: normal CI and current source governance0 under separate scope
actual F0 binds reviewed mechanism/template/native request/current baseline
explicit B_SETUP and exact commit mode
ordinary native started separately; confirm only-own setup delta
capture actual upstream protection/governance, then final intent/two hashes/candidate/diff/F1
external gate and conditional or final commit authority
one commit call, then separate readonly afterchecks and truthful native lifecycle
user_decision_authentication: manual actual instruction provenance required; JSON shape/hash consistency does not authenticate consent
actual_source_callsite_binding: must bind exact caller code/loaded identity/parameters at source phase; this preparation ABI does not claim source invocation acceptance
